newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Too rapid NZ dlr rise can hurt exports - Birch.
newsitem.headline: Too rapid NZ dlr rise can hurt exports - Birch.

text.p: New Zealand caretaker Finance Minister Bill Birch said on Friday it was obvious that too rapid a rise in the exchange rate could damage export growth.
"Let me try briefly to state the obvious. If the exchange rate rises too fast, it can seriously damage ongoing growth in the export sector," Birch said in a speech to farmers.
Birch added: "On the other hand, where lower exchange rates result in higher inflation, then rising cost structures nationwide may cause greater damage to international competitiveness."
Birch was at pains to emphasise that it would be inappropriate for him to make any personal or government comment on monetary policy.
The conservative National Party is currently playing what he called a "limited caretaker role" after an inconclusive general election.
The nationalist New Zealand First party, which holds the balance of power, is negotiating with both National and Labour on coalition-building.
